# Naviamp v2.7.0 — Flexible text sizes and smoother player animations

Naviamp 2.7.0 adds independent text-size controls for Now Playing and the rest of the interface. It
also makes player animations substantially lighter and smoother across Android, iOS, macOS,
Windows, and Linux, with improvements to library browsing, playback reporting, lyrics, and artwork.

## Highlights

- Choose Small, Standard, or Large text independently for Now Playing and the rest of the interface.
- Smooth titles and waveform progress now use small cached compositor surfaces instead of repeatedly redrawing the whole window.
- Browse refreshed Recently added albums, sort by date added, and manage source libraries directly from the Library page.

## Features

- Add independent Small, Standard, and Large text-size settings for Now Playing and the general interface. Both choices continue to respect the operating system's accessibility scale. ([Issue #25](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/25), [PR #111](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/111))

## Improvements

- Make scrolling titles and smooth waveform progress substantially more efficient across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux while preserving seeking, links, keyboard input, accessibility, clipping, and popup behavior. The Android fix also keeps cached content aligned while scrolling and prevents blank or flickering waveform replacements. ([Issue #102](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/102), [PR #106](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/106), [Issue #112](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/112), [PR #113](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/113), [Issue #114](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/114), [PR #115](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/115), [Issue #116](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/116), [PR #117](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/117))
- Refresh Recently added albums correctly, add date-added Library sorting, and move source-library selection into the Library page with friendly names and recoverable provider errors. ([Issue #90](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/90), [PR #91](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/91), [Issue #23](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/23), [PR #96](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/96))
- Enable Sonic similarity automatically when a server advertises support, while preserving an explicit user choice and refreshing the current track immediately when the setting changes. ([Issue #97](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/97), [PR #100](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/100))
- Reduce Android release download size through code and resource optimization while retaining native crash symbols and diagnostics. ([Issue #93](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/93), [PR #103](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/103))
- Require deliberate horizontal movement before a row swipe action takes over, reducing accidental actions during vertical scrolling. ([Issue #21](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/21), [PR #94](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/94))

## Bug fixes

- Make Navidrome listen reporting reliable across scrobble modes and avoid duplicate or missing submissions during playback transitions. ([Issue #89](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/89), [PR #92](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/92))
- Keep the active track, playback position, pause state, and history when refreshing track radio from Now Playing. ([Issue #99](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/99), [PR #107](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/107))
- Show Navidrome participation albums under Appears On when an artist is credited on individual tracks. ([Issue #104](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/104), [PR #109](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/109))
- Display Navidrome WebP artwork on desktop and retain provider artwork when an external artist image fails. ([Issue #105](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/105), [PR #108](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/108))
- Keep the active synchronized lyric line centered using its rendered size, and clear lyrics from the previous track while new lyrics load. ([Issue #101](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/101), [PR #110](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/110))

## Upgrade notes

- Existing v2.x installations can upgrade in place. No special upgrade steps are required.
- Update both ends of a Naviamp Connect session to this release.

## Known issues

- Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta while broader device compatibility, network recovery, and performance testing continues.
- The iOS artifact remains an unsigned preview. Windows and macOS packages are not publisher-signed and may show operating-system warnings.
